Author: bdg
Name: Artisan GBR Bridge
Punchline: Sends Artisan's "Gather Item" into a GatherBuddy Reborn list.
Description: Artisan only knows how to talk to the original GatherBuddy, and its check is simply whether a plugin called GatherBuddy is loaded - so this one carries that name to switch the greyed-out "Gather Item" entry back on. Clicking it now files the ingredient into a GatherBuddy Reborn auto-gather list named after the crafting list it came from, with the amount you are still missing; click more ingredients and they join the same list. Typing /gather or /gatherfish yourself is untouched and still goes straight to GatherBuddy Reborn. Requires Artisan and GatherBuddy Reborn; the original GatherBuddy must not be running.
